subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add bounded orphan SKILL.md detection outside configured skill roots, and should it run in `skills check`, Doctor, status/startup, or docs only?
rationale: The missing diagnostic is clear, but scanning outside configured roots changes privacy, performance, false-positive, and startup-noise behavior that automation should not decide.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add a bounded orphan scan to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and remediation to move, install, or configure the skill.

options.title: Also Warn At Startup
options.body: Surface the same warning during startup or status, accepting extra runtime scanning and operator-visible noise.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs instead of adding off-root filesystem scanning.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add a bounded orphan scan to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and remediation to move, install, or configure the skill.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history signal across skill creation, skills lifecycle, and the product boundary for diagnostics.
